Information
Points to Master: 5000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Thought Acceleration: Increase magic casting speed multiplier by 4, increase movement speed by 0.01 (0.02 with Mastery), increase attack speed by 0.2 (0.4 with Mastery)

[Passive, True] All of Creation: The user instantly learns all Aspectual Magic. The user instantly learns all Recipes.

[Passive, Toggle] Parallel Processing: Increases the amount of Learned Points and Mastery Points gained when learning/using Skills, Magic, Battlewill, and Arts by 14 (15 Total).

[Passive, Toggle] Chant Annulment: For Magic, casting becomes instant. User will be able to cast magic even when air level is under max or silence effect is active. Enchantment particles are also reduced.

Active

[Active, Press] Alteration: Open the Skill Alteration Menu. The Skill Alteration Menu allows you to select a skill and evolve it forcefully, however the requirements must be met.

[Active, Press] Integrate: When used while staring at a Body Double, the user can project the consciousness of Raphael inside of the Body Double. When the Ego of Raphael is inside of the Body Double, it will be capable of using the Aspectual Magics you know. When the Manas of Raphael is inside of the Body Double, it will be capable of using the Skills you know as well.

[Active, Press] Report & Converse: When used normally, Raphael will scan the immediate area, and detect any nearby players which aren't your subordinates. It will affect them with glowing, and assess their threat level by classifying it. When used while shifting, Raphael will speak to you, with a chance of gaining more mastery, when mastered this instead will increase the Sociality of your skill's Ego. When raised enough, you may name the Ego.

[Active, Press] Analysis: When used while looking at a mob, copies 1 of the Magic, and Skills (Except Unique Skills & Resistances) of a target. Can copy from up to 20 blocks away while in line of sight of entity or magic circle and won't work on any spirit related magic.

[Active, Press] Refining: Opens a GUI that can be used to craft things, brew potions and process magic ore

Shift use Crafting: Opens a crafting GUI that also has an option to Decraft items into their base components. Second tab is a combination of anvil (without renaming) and grindstone (be able to select what enchantments to remove). Using the anvil function to combine enchantments allows it to bypass the vanilla cap of obtainable levels of an enchant By a max of 2 Levels above Vanilla Max.

[Active - Press] Synthesize: When used, if the user is looking at a Charybdis Core, gain skills and EP based on the Core’s state. If the player is looking at a mob tagged Spiritual that is at 25% hp or lower, the mob perishes and the player gains all the skills and EP of the mob, only works once per mob type. (Cannot be a summoned spirit, has to be found in the wild)

Information
Points to Master: 5000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Secret Bearer - The user gains access to the "Raziel Commands".

Name | Changes the Secret Identity given when the skill is toggled on.

Locate | Allows the user to obtain the coordinates of any of their subordinates. This can be disabled in the Raziel config.

Rename | Allows the user to set the temporary name of a target that is hit by "Rename". If this is disabled in the config, the name will default to "Ant", "Rat" or "Whelp".

Any Ultimate Skills obtained by the user will be removed by Raziel. Raziel will "Deconstruct them," refunding the user the MP and gaining a Secret Marker. When Raziel reaches 4 Secret Markers, it will awaken the "Secretive Ego" of Raziel.

Unlike other Egos, in order to to develop it, you must use Erase on enough strong targets.

[Passive, Toggled] Secret Identity - The user's name becomes ??? while this skill is toggled on. The user can change this with /trnightmare raziel name 'Name Here'. The user becomes immune to Charm and cannot become someone's subordinate while this skill is toggled on. Skills that would attempt to copy or learn from the user, are rendered null while this skill is toggled on.

Active

[Active, In-Slot] Ink Manipulation - When you hit a target with physical damage, the target is inflicted with the Inked Effect. If the target is brought to Inked Level 5 by Ink Manipulation, their name is replaced with the Rename stated by the command, or one of the three default ones. If the Inked Effect reaches level 12, the target is inflicted with Anti Skill for 20 seconds, and the Inked Effect runs out. Targets who are renamed have their damage reduced by 80% until the Inked Effect runs out.

[Active, Press] Confined Secrets - The user can use this to seal a random skill of the target. The target will forget the skill and relearn it when this skill's cooldown is over. This skill will target Unique Skills first, if there are no Unique Skills to be sealed, the user will attempt to seal an Ultimate Skill. This only has a 50% chance to seal an Ultimate Skill, 75% when mastered.

[Active, In-Slot] Secretive Intentions - While this is in-slot, the user ignores Dodge Bypass and Dodge Chance; they become totally unreadable, even by the likes of Future Sight.

[Active, Press] Erase (Requires Mastery) - When the target reaches Inked 30, the user can use Erase to remove their existence. The user will then record and learn all non-unique or ultimate skills from a target, including their Magics and Battlewills. There is a 15% Chance for this to copy Unique Skills.

Information
Points to Master: 100

Costs 5000 mp and 2 spiritrons to use

Active

[Active - Chant] Chant for 10 seconds. After 10 seconds have passed, for the rest of the time the user holds the spell: the user cannot walk or run, allies within 6 blocks (increases to 10 on mastery) will heal 50 hp per second at the cost (this cost is paid by the spellcaster) of 2 spiritrons and 5k magicules per ally each time they are healed.

Information
Points to Master: 100

Active

[Active, Press] Restores a maximum of 10 Million Magicules to the player with a 30 minute cooldown. This cannot exceed your maximum magicules.

Information
Points to Master: 1000

Active

[Active, Press] Deconstruct: Data - Open a menu containing the user‘s entire list of skills, if skill is selected, add 1/2 of the skill‘s obtainment cost to the user‘s maximum MP, and 1/2 to the skill.

[Active, Press] Deconstruct: Object - Delete the item in the user‘s main hand and if it had an EP value, add half of it to the user‘s maximum AP and the skill‘s storedMP. 30 second cooldown.

Information
Points to Master: 1000
Passive: Toggle

Passive

[Passive, True] Spiritron Collection - The user gains a new Energy bar below their MP and AP Bars, this containts the user's Spiritron Point Bar. This bar will passively fill up so long as the user's MP is at 90% or higher. The Spiritron bar will regenerate 1 Spiritron a second (5 when mastered) and has a maximum size of 100.

[Passive, In-slot] Purified Attacks - While the user's SP Bar is at 50 or higher, the user does Holy Damage 20 Holy Damage (40 when mastered) on hitting an entity with physical damage.

[Passive, Toggled] Holy Miracle - When toggled, the user will increase all Holy Damage by +25 (+75 when mastered), but the user 50 (25 when mastered) damage whenever they deal Holy Damage.

Active

[Active, Held] Disintegration - The user begins to chant and Disintegration spell, using 75 Spiritrons to cast, along with 25,000 MP the user uses Disintegration, which does 150 Holy Damage.

[Active, Press] Melt Cut (Requires Mastery) - The user coats their blade in Holy Magic, allowing them to deal Holy Damage by attacking an enemy. This deals 75 Holy Damage on hit, with a 1 second cooldon.

Information
Passive: Toggle

"Oi mate, this is spider Central HQ; your gonna get poisoned no matter what you do" 

Passive

[Passive, True] Spacetime Manipulation

[Passive, Toggle] Thought Acceleration

[Passive, In-Slot] Detect Weakness - While this skill is in slot, entities you hit will progress the production of your Lethal Dose.

Actives

[Active, In-Slot] Bloody Bite - The user strikes at an enemy, spending some of their MP to inject them with their Poison. If the Detect Weakness is at 30% of less, this move only deals Physical and Spiritual Damage. (Halved by Abnormal Condition Resistance, reduced by 25% with Nullification). If Detect Weakness is at 50%, it infects them with Magicule Poisoning. If Detect Weakness is at 80%, it becomes Lethal Poison. If it is at 100%, it becomes Cursed Poison.

[Active, Hold] Poison Refinement - While Held, this move will slowly drain the user's MP and begin producing 2.5% (5% on mastery) of the progress for your Lethal Dose a second.

[Active, Press] Death World - This can only be used when your Lethal Dose is at 100%. The user pulls all targets into their Death World Dimension. All entities inside of the Death World without [Samael,Lord of deadly Poison] are given Cursed Poison 3.

Any target pulled it which is not both a Spiritual Lifeform and wields an Ultimate Skill is instantly killed, otherwise, it deals 25 Spiritual Damage + 5% of the user's Nihility as 1/2 of it is used to deal Void Damage per second. 

[Active, In-Slot] Nihilistic Poison - The user begins to release their Nihility much faster, draining it into their palm, this makes it so the Nihility is drained by 3.5% on hit (2% when mastered) to gain a bonus 5% on the target's Lethal Dose. When the Lethal Dose is at 100%, they will take 200 Spiritual Damage + 10% of the user's Nihility as Void Damage.

[Active, In-Slot] Nihility Supply (Requires Mastery) - While the user can generate Nihility passively in slot as they develop their Lethal Dose, they gain 1 Nihility for every Lethal Dose % they gain. Their Nihility can scale up to 10,000 points before the user begins to take 50 Void Damage a second until it is decreased below 10,000. The user can have a maximum of 25,000 Nihility.

Nihility Generation is 20 Spatial Damage to 1 Nihility.

[Active, Press] Multidimensional Barrier - Like the extra Skill Multilayer Barrier

Information
Passive: Toggle

"The judge has spoken. Your verdict stands" 

Passive

[Passive, Toggle] Silent Movement - The player makes zero noise, undetectable by Sculk or Sense Sound Wave.

Passive

[Active, In-Slot] Remove - The user instantly breaks Barriers. 5 Second Cooldown

[Active In-Slot] Dispel - The user automatically removes certain conditions from the user. The user removes various conditions from the target on it. 3 Second Cooldown. (configurable in config)

[Active, In-Slot] Eraser - The user's attacks on enemies damage their Current MP. If the target has less than 15% of the user's EP, they are instantly killed, other wise each attack reduces their Current MP by 5% (2.5% if they have an ultimate skill). 2 Second Cooldown.

[Active, In-Slot] Necrosis - This applies the Necrotic Effect to a target. Necrotic makes it so they cannot regenerate Magicules and Regeneration Skills do not work. This has a 30 Second Cooldown and the condition lasts 25 Seconds.

[Active, In-Slot] Judgement - When used, Remove, Dispel, Eraser and Necrosis are all used together, but enhanced.

Dispel now deals bonus damage directly to the target based off the Barrier Points destroyed (1 Barrier Point = 5 Damage)

Dispel now bypasses Resistances and Nullifications

Eraser will instantly kill any target target with less than 50% of the user's EP by reducing their Current EP to 0%, otherwise reduce their Current EP by the difference between the User and Target's Current EP (0 if the target has higher EP) + 35% of the target's current EP.

Necrosis will apply the Necrotic Effect for 1 minute.

This has a 1,440 second cooldown.
